title: ToolDex: An Ego-Exo Human Demonstration Dataset for Creative Physical Tool Use
title_zh: ToolDex：面向创造性物理工具使用的第一人称-第三人称人类示范数据集

paragraphs.en: 发布ToolDex大规模第一与第三人称人类工具使用数据集，并建立推理、重建与机器人策略学习三项基准。 Creative tool use is a fundamental human capability and an important step toward general-purpose embodied intelligence. It requires agents to reason about object affordances, physical constraints, and manipulation strategies, especially when standard tools are unavailable. However, progress in this area is limited by the lack of real-world datasets that capture human tool-use behavior with sufficient scale, fidelity, and diversity. Existing benchmarks are often simulation-based, focus on simplified interactions, or lack detailed observations and annotations. We introduce ToolDex, a large-scale egocentric-exocentric (ego-exo) human demonstration dataset for creative physical tool use. ToolDex captures scenarios in which humans select, adapt, and repurpose available objects as tools. Using synchronized egocentric cameras and eight exocentric cameras, the dataset provides high-fidelity multi-view observations and rich annotations for hands, tools, target objects, and their deformable interactions. Beyond data collection, we establish a benchmark suite characterizing three core capabilities: physical tool-use reasoning, sparse-view 3D and 4D reconstruction, and robot policy learning. ToolDex provides a foundation for studying human tool-use behavior and developing embodied agents that can adaptively use tools in complex real-world environments. Dataset visualizations and benchmarking results are available at https://tooluse-dataset.github.io/.
paragraphs.zh: 发布ToolDex大规模第一与第三人称人类工具使用数据集，并建立推理、重建与机器人策略学习三项基准。创造性工具使用是人类的一项基本能力，也是迈向通用具身智能的重要一步。 它要求智能体对物体的可供性、物理约束和操作策略进行推理，尤其是在标准工具不可用的情况下。 然而，该领域的进展受限于缺乏以足够的规模、保真度和多样性捕捉人类工具使用行为的真实世界数据集。 现有基准通常基于仿真，聚焦于简化交互，或缺乏详细的观测与标注。 我们提出ToolDex，一个面向创造性物理工具使用的大规模第一人称-第三人称（ego-exo）人类示范数据集。 ToolDex捕捉了人类选择、改造和重新利用现有物体作为工具的场景。 通过同步的第一人称相机和八台第三人称相机，该数据集提供了高保真的多视角观测，以及针对手部、工具、目标物体及其可变形交互的丰富标注。 除数据收集外，我们还建立了一个基准套件，刻画三项核心能力：物理工具使用推理、稀疏视角3D与4D重建，以及机器人策略学习。 ToolDex为研究人类工具使用行为以及开发能够在复杂真实世界环境中自适应使用工具的具身智能体奠定了基础。 数据集可视化与基准测试结果可在 https://tooluse-dataset.github.io/ 获取。
